01安全与地缘 · 2026年11月6日

海湾油轮遇袭致海员身亡，VLCC 在霍尔木兹水线爆炸

Seafarer Killed in Gulf Tanker Attack as VLCC Suffers Waterline Blast off Hormuz

One seafarer was killed when a tanker was attacked in the Gulf, and a VLCC reported a waterline explosion on an outbound Strait of Hormuz transit. The Marshall Islands-flagged product tanker Velos Sapphire (74,998 dwt) was hit by two unidentified projectiles about 50 nm north of Qatar on 4 November; its manager confirmed on 6 November that one seafarer had died, and the vessel reached Bahrain's Khalifa Bin Salman Port. The Vanuatu-flagged VLCC Vieira reported a waterline explosion about 16 nm east of Khasab, Oman, on 5 November; all crew were safe and the vessel remained under power. Seven vessels have been reported attacked in the region since the start of November.

一艘油轮在海湾遇袭后一名海员身亡，另有一艘 VLCC 在霍尔木兹海峡出口航道水线处发生爆炸。马绍尔群岛籍成品油轮 Velos Sapphire（74,998 载重吨）11 月 4 日在卡塔尔以北约 50 海里处遭两枚不明抛射物击中，船东 11 月 6 日确认一名海员死亡，船舶已抵达巴林哈利法·本·萨勒曼港。另一艘瓦努阿图籍 VLCC Vieira 11 月 5 日在阿曼哈萨卜以东约 16 海里处水线爆炸，全体船员安全，船舶仍可自航。自 11 月以来该区域已报告七艘船舶遇袭。

02安全与地缘 · 2026年11月6日

伊朗重划霍尔木兹黑名单，商船通行量跌至冲突前约一成

Iran Redraws Hormuz Blacklist as Commercial Transits Fall to a Tenth of Pre-Conflict Levels

Iran's strait authority has redrawn its list of non-compliant vessels for the Strait of Hormuz as commercial traffic through the waterway collapses. The Persian Gulf Strait Authority removed two US-sanctioned LPG carriers, Gas Marakua and SOGL, from its list and added the tanker Mercan, leaving 239 vessels blacklisted, far above the 77 listed in September. The Joint Maritime Information Centre recorded only about nine commercial Hormuz crossings on Thursday, roughly a tenth of the pre-conflict level of about 85 a day.

伊朗海峡管理机构调整了霍尔木兹海峡“不合规”船舶名单，商船通行量已大幅萎缩。伊朗波斯湾海峡管理局将两艘受美国制裁的 LPG 船（Gas Marakua、SOGL）移出名单，同时新增油轮 Mercan，黑名单船舶总数为 239 艘，远高于 9 月的 77 艘。联合海事信息中心记录显示，霍尔木兹海峡商业船舶通行量上周四仅约 9 艘次，约为冲突前每天约 85 艘次的一成。

美国制裁五艘古巴油轮，加码打击古巴石油航运网络

US Sanctions Five Cuban Tankers in Fresh Crackdown on Oil Shipping Networks

Washington has widened its sanctions campaign against Cuba's oil shipping network, identifying five Cuban-flagged tankers as blocked property. The tankers are Esperanza, Gloria C, Maria Cristina, Emilia and Lourdes, and eight companies and two individuals in Cyprus, Panama and Havana were also targeted. Cyprus-based Caroil Transport Marine commercially manages the first three vessels and has itself been sanctioned since 2019. Authorised humanitarian trade in food and medicines remains exempt.

美国扩大对古巴石油航运网络的制裁，认定五艘古巴籍油轮为被冻结财产。被制裁油轮为 Esperanza、Gloria C、Maria Cristina、Emilia 和 Lourdes，同时被针对的还有塞浦路斯、巴拿马和哈瓦那的八家公司和两名个人。塞浦路斯的 Caroil Transport Marine 负责其中前三艘船的商业管理，该公司自 2019 年起已受制裁。食品和药品等人道主义贸易仍获豁免。

04安全与地缘 / 集装箱 · 2026年11月7日

德路里预测东西航线 46 个空白航次，亚欧航线占一半

Drewry Forecasts 46 Blank Sailings on East-West Trades, Half on Asia–Europe

Drewry's 6 November cancelled-sailings assessment forecasts 46 blank sailings over weeks 46 to 50, covering 9 November to 14 December, on major East-West trades. The cancellations represent about 6% of 717 scheduled sailings, with Asia–North Europe and Mediterranean trades accounting for half, transpacific eastbound services 35% and transatlantic services 15%. The forecast coincides with carriers selectively resuming Suez Canal services. UKMTO issued Warning 197-26 the same day, recording a waterline explosion aboard an outbound tanker in the Strait of Hormuz; all crew were safe.

德路里 11 月 6 日的停航评估预测，东西主干航线在第 46 至 50 周（11 月 9 日至 12 月 14 日）将有 46 个空白航次。取消航次约占 717 个计划航次的 6%，其中亚欧与地中海航线占一半，跨太平洋东向航线占 35%，跨大西洋航线占 15%。该预测与部分船公司恢复苏伊士运河航线的时间点重合。UKMTO 同日发布 197-26 号警告，记录一艘油轮在霍尔木兹出口航道水线爆炸，船员全部安全。

05能源与油气 / 油价 · 2026年11月6日

油价周五反弹，但周线仍大幅下跌

Oil Extends Rebound but Heads for Sharp Weekly Drop

Oil pushed higher on Friday, extending Thursday's rebound, but remained on track for a steep weekly loss. Brent crude for January traded near $100 a barrel after settling at $98.29 on 5 November (+3.88%), with WTI at $90.52 (+2.72%). Despite the two-day rebound, front-month futures were down roughly 12% on the week by Reuters' count and about 15% by Bloomberg's — the two sources differ. Traders weighed Middle East supply risks, with oil shipments through Hormuz estimated below 60% of capacity and at least five vessel incidents reported since Sunday.

油价周五延续反弹，但全周仍大幅下跌。布伦特 1 月期货 11 月 6 日盘中一度接近每桶 100 美元，此前一天结算价为 98.29 美元（+3.88%），WTI 结算价 90.52 美元（+2.72%）。尽管连续两日反弹，周线跌幅仍约 12%（路透口径）至 15%（彭博口径），两来源口径不一。市场担忧中东供应，分析估计经霍尔木兹海峡的石油运输量不足运力六成，自上周日以来已报告至少五起船舶事件。

ADNOC 与印度 Gujarat Energy 签署十年 LNG 供应协议

ADNOC Signs 10-Year LNG Supply Deal with India's Gujarat Energy

ADNOC has signed a 10-year LNG supply agreement with India's Gujarat Energy, expanding its presence in a key Asian LNG market. Under the deal, Gujarat Energy will procure up to 4 million tonnes over 10 years from 2028, sourced from the international portfolio of XRG, ADNOC's investment arm — ADNOC's fifth LNG supply deal in India. The agreement was finalised through ADNOC's global LNG marketing and trading platform, targeting 47 mtpa of marketable LNG beyond 2030.

QatarEnergy Eyes NextDecade Train 6 Supply in Latest US LNG Push

QatarEnergy is in advanced talks with NextDecade to buy up to 2 mtpa of LNG from Train 6 of the Rio Grande LNG facility in Texas, two people familiar with the matter said. The train is still in permitting and has not reached a final investment decision, while capacity from the first five trains — expected to produce about 30 mtpa when fully operational — is already sold out. QatarEnergy CEO Saad Sherida Al-Kaabi has said the US LNG buying strategy aims at revenue resilience if Hormuz exports are disrupted again.

台湾关闭巴布亚新几内亚办事处，停止采购其 LNG

Taiwan Shuts Papua New Guinea Office and Ends LNG Buying, Citing Chinese Pressure

Taiwan said on Friday it had decided to shut its representative office in Papua New Guinea and stop buying LNG from the country, blaming Chinese pressure after Port Moresby demanded staff leave within a set deadline. Taiwan's foreign ministry said it had stopped spot LNG purchases from PNG, planned at about 500,000 tonnes in the first half of 2026, and will sign no new spot gas contracts with the country. Taiwan has long been an important market for PNG gas, accounting for roughly a third of its total LNG exports.

台湾方面 11 月 6 日表示，决定关闭驻巴布亚新几内亚代表处并停止采购该国 LNG，原因是中方施压。台湾外事部门称，已停止向巴新采购现货 LNG，原计划 2026 年上半年采购约 50 万吨，且不再与该国签署新的现货天然气合同。台湾长期是巴新天然气的重要市场，约占其 LNG 出口总量的三分之一。

Excelerate 与巴哈马签署 11 年 LNG 供应协议

Excelerate Signs 11-Year Bahamas LNG Deal

Excelerate Energy has secured an 11-year LNG supply agreement for a planned energy hub in The Bahamas, providing up to 16 TBtu of LNG annually. Initial deliveries are expected from its Jamaican operations in the first quarter of 2027, with anchor customer AxDo Bahamas — a joint venture of Axpo and Domicisle LNG — taking supply at a proposed offshore LNG storage and distribution terminal near Grand Bahama, with a floating storage unit planned for 2028. The hub is designed to serve power generation, marine operators and LNG bunkering for cruise ships along a major Caribbean shipping corridor.

美国 Excelerate Energy 为巴哈马计划中的能源枢纽签署 11 年 LNG 供应协议，每年供应至多 16 TBtu LNG。首批交付预计 2027 年第一季度从其牙买加业务发出，锚定客户为 Axpo 与 Domicisle LNG 的合资公司 AxDo Bahamas，供应将通过大巴哈马岛附近拟建的海上 LNG 储存与分销终端进行，2028 年计划部署一座浮式储存装置。该枢纽还将服务发电、海运运营商以及沿加勒比主要航运走廊的邮轮 LNG 加注。

EnerMech 赢得雪佛龙赤道几内亚管道预调试合同

EnerMech Picks Up Chevron Pipeline Work off Equatorial Guinea

UK-headquartered EnerMech has won a Chevron contract for pipeline pre-commissioning services on the Aseng gas development offshore Equatorial Guinea. The scope covers preparation of about 19 km of rigid production flowline connecting the Aseng field to existing infrastructure, managed from EnerMech's Houston base. 造船热潮面临 2028 年交付挤压，订单量创纪录

Shipbuilding Boom Heads for 2028 Delivery Crunch

The global shipbuilding orderbook has hit a record high, setting up a delivery squeeze in 2027–2028. Danish Ship Finance's November 2026 Shipping Market Review finds the orderbook has grown 3.5 times since 2020 while yard capacity grew only 30%, with order cover up from 1.4 years in 2020 to 3.7 years and the orderbook now equal to 19% of the world fleet. Clarksons Research reports a record orderbook of 226.1m cgt — above the September 2008 peak of 225.5m cgt — worth about $700bn, with China holding 68% of orders. The best-performing yards are booked at 164% of capacity for 2028, and an estimated 10–11m cgt of deliveries could slip in each of 2027 and 2028.

全球造船订单量创下纪录，2027–2028 年交付面临挤压。丹麦船舶融资公司 2026 年 11 月市场回顾显示，全球手持订单自 2020 年以来增长 3.5 倍，船厂产能仅增长 30%，订单覆盖期从 2020 年的 1.4 年升至 3.7 年，手持订单相当于现有船队的 19%。克拉克森数据显示订单量达创纪录的 2.261 亿修正总吨，超过 2008 年 9 月峰值，订单总值约 7,000 亿美元，中国占 68%。表现最好的船厂 2028 年产能预订率达 164%，2027 年和 2028 年每年可能各有 1,000–1,100 万修正总吨交付延期。

Venergy 在恒力再订两艘 VLCC，油轮新造订单翻倍

Venergy Doubles VLCC Order at Hengli

Greek shipowner Venergy Maritime has firmed up another two VLCCs at China's Hengli Heavy Industries, doubling its debut supertanker order. The move brings Venergy's newbuilding programme to 26 tankers across the MR2, LR2, suezmax and VLCC segments, and owner Vyron Vasileiadis has committed more than $2bn to fleet expansion over roughly 16 months. The owner has also booked suezmaxes at Shanghai Waigaoqiao and Guangzhou Shipyard International.

Second Term for Arsenio Dominguez Backed by IMO Council

The IMO Council has decided to extend Secretary-General Arsenio Dominguez's mandate for a second term from 1 January 2028 to 31 December 2031, to be submitted to the IMO Assembly in late 2027. Dominguez, who took office in early 2024, has led the IMO through a difficult period on decarbonisation, with the Net Zero Framework delayed at MEPC last year and due for a vote again on 4 December. His tenure has also coincided with increased geopolitical tensions in which commercial ships and seafarers have become targets in the Black Sea and Middle East.

High-profile battery fires on container ships and car carriers are hitting headlines with growing frequency, but safety regulations continue to lag behind and marine insurers are increasingly concerned about the scale of risk. New EU Rules Could Boost Bio-LNG Demand in Maritime Transport, IEA Says

The IEA's Renewables 2026 report says the EU's FuelEU Maritime regulation, in force since 2025, could stimulate bio-LNG use in shipping, with ships over 5,000 GT calling at EU ports required to cut the GHG intensity of energy used by 2% in 2025, 6% in 2030 and 80% by 2050 versus 2020. The IEA noted 222 ports had LNG bunkering infrastructure in 2025, with 62 more under construction, and LNG-powered vessels more than doubled between 2022 and 2025 to 853. Several shipping companies are already signing long-term bio-LNG supply and bunkering agreements in Europe, China, Singapore and the US.

国际能源署（IEA）《可再生能源 2026》报告称，欧盟自 2025 年起实施的 FuelEU Maritime 法规可能刺激海运生物 LNG 的使用。根据该法规，挂靠欧盟港口的 5,000 总吨以上船舶，能源温室气体强度须较 2020 年在 2025 年降低 2%、2030 年降低 6%、2050 年降低 80%。IEA 指出，2025 年全球已有 222 个港口具备 LNG 加注设施，另有 62 个在建；LNG 动力船舶数量 2022 年至 2025 年间翻倍以上，达 853 艘。多家船公司已在欧洲、中国、新加坡和美国签署长期生物 LNG 供应与加注协议。
